finding.summary: Wouldn't `stderr` then a failure exit code cause this to not reject?  Because it would resolve first and then never reject.

label: real_issue
label_reason: A human reviewer raised this in typeorm/typeorm#6889 (merged 2021-03-08), and a later commit in the PR changes the file.
notes: Hand-picked with Claude Code (PMAT-310): https://github.com/typeorm/typeorm/pull/6889. TypeScript: stderr resolves the promise before the failure can reject it. Human reviewers are not perfect ground truth, and they give no severity, so any severity counts.
